cues: On that thin diet Varma weakens, and pills and tonics take the place of food: for his bowels, his blood pressure, his arthritis, and finally to keep his heart beating.
There are rushes to hospital and the humiliation of the stomach pump.
When the old man begs, let me die, his son replies that he has his duty.
